title: Constraint and equation satisfaction
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a finite set, and let $c$ be a constraint in the maximum-arity linear template over the two-element field $ F_2$. Thus $c$ applies a parity equation with a nonempty scope of at most $r$ distinct variables and a right-hand side in $ F_2$. For every assignment of elements of $ F_2$ to $V$, the associated linear equation is satisfied if and only if $c$ is satisfied.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a constraint in the maximum-arity linear template
the constraint has a nonempty scope of at most $r$ distinct variables
